The '''Rishi Base''' was a [[Smugglers' Alliance]] base on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]], near [[Wozwashi Street]].

==History==
The Rishi Base was one of [[Talon Karrde]]'s bases. It became the main base of operations for the [[Smugglers' Alliance]] after his [[Myrkr Base|base]] at [[Myrkr/Legends|Myrkr]] was [[Rescue on Myrkr|compromised]] during the [[Thrawn campaign]]. The base was quickly abandoned after the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Gunner Groth]] discovered the presence of Karrde's smugglers on Rishi.
